overview: This brief portion of the Marathon County Extension, Education, and Economic Development Committee meeting returned from closed session and focused on scheduling a joint meeting with HR, Finance, and Property committees. The committee confirmed a joint meeting for September 9th at 3:00 p.m. to continue discussions on an unspecified matter decided in closed session, then adjourned.

discussions.item: Joint Meeting Scheduling with HR, Finance, and Property
discussions.body: Upon returning from closed session, the presiding official announced a joint meeting with HR, Finance, and Property committees scheduled for Wednesday, September 9th at 3:00 p.m. to continue discussions and determine how to move forward on the matter addressed in closed session. Committee members online, including Supervisor Foot, confirmed their availability to attend and meet quorum requirements.
The presiding official announced that the October 1st meeting would include the STRAP plan on the agenda, and encouraged committee members to review it ahead of time to be prepared for discussion.
A motion to adjourn was made by Seefeldt and seconded by Lammer. The motion passed on a voice vote with all members saying 'I.'
